caption: A sealed, half-crushed plastic water bottle is dropped into a bowl of hot water, and its crushed sides push back out until the bottle is round.

sa.check: The bottle is dropped into a bowl of hot water.
The bottle ends round and taut.
The drop comes first and the pushing out follows.

pc.expect: The dents move outward until the bottle's walls are round and taut, and the bottle stays one bottle of the same size.
pc.fail: The dents press in further instead of pushing out; or new dents appear elsewhere on the bottle; or the bottle swells far beyond its original size; or the bottle turns into another shape such as a cube.

pc.expect: The change runs one way in the hot water: the dents only come out and do not press back in.
pc.fail: A dent pushes out and then presses back in while the bottle stays in the hot water; or the dents come and go in turn; or the dents push out before the bottle reaches the water; or the walls ripple back and forth.

pc.expect: The bottle floats at the surface, bobbing, and the water stays level in the bowl.
pc.fail: The bottle sinks to the bowl's floor and stays; or hangs motionless in mid-water; or rises out of the water and hangs above it; or the water's surface tilts and stays tilted with the bowl level.

pc.expect: The drop has an effect: the water splashes and ripples where the bottle lands and the bottle is wetted.
pc.fail: The bottle enters and the surface stays glassy; or the water ripples before the bottle reaches it; or the bottle stays dry while floating; or the dents push out while the bottle is still in the air above the water.

pc.expect: One bottle and one bowl; the bottle stays sealed in the water and nothing passes through the bowl.
pc.fail: The bottle vanishes; or a second bottle appears; or water passes into the sealed bottle through its wall; or the bottle passes through the bowl's wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bottle's label, its cap and the bowl stay the same.
pc.fail: The label changes; or the cap changes colour; or the bowl changes pattern.
